name: UI Scaling
teaser: BepInEx client plugin that unlocks UI scaling to properly fill the screen at higher resolutions
description:
SPT-UIScale

NOTE: This was a mod I made because I got side tracked while trying to fix my other mods and a friend of mine playing SPT had a bag that didn’t fit in the UI properly. I probably wont spend anymore time on this unless there’s a major SPT version release

BepInEx client plugin for SPT 4.0.13 that unlocks UI scaling for the inventory and trader screens. Overrides EFT’s hardcoded 1080p canvas scaling with a configurable percentage, and adjusts panel layouts so the stash and gear panels properly fill the screen at higher resolutions.

Once custom scale is set youll need to either restart the client or change resolutions for the affect to take place*

Features

  • Configurable UI scale as a percentage of vanilla (50–150%)
  • Automatically adjusts when changing resolution in-game
  • Inventory screen: gear panel expands to fill available space, stash anchored to the right
  • Trader screen: trader items anchored left, stash anchored right, deal panel centered
  • Works with any resolution (1440p, 4K, ultrawide, etc.)

Installation

  1. Download the latest release ZIP
  2. Extract into your SPT installation directory — the DLL goes to BepInEx/plugins/
  3. Launch SPT

Configuration

After first launch, edit BepInEx/config/com.vonbraunz.uiscale.cfg:

Setting Default Description
Enabled true Toggle the mod on/off without uninstalling
Scale Percent 100 UI scale as a percentage of vanilla. 100 = no change, 75 = 75% size (more grid space), 50 = half size. Range: 50–150
Log Canvas Names false Debug logging to BepInEx console

Recommended values

Resolution Scale Percent Effect
1080p 100 No change (vanilla)
1440p 75–85 More inventory/stash space
4K 50–75 Significantly more grid space

What it does

Overrides EFT’s hardcoded 1080p UI scaling, giving you more inventory and stash grid space at higher resolutions.

Features

  • Configurable scale percentage (50–150% of vanilla)
  • Automatically adjusts when changing resolution in-game
  • Inventory screen layout fix: gear panel expands, stash anchored right
  • Trader screen layout fix: trader items anchored left, stash anchored right
  • Works at any resolution (1440p, 4K, ultrawide)

Installation

  1. Extract the ZIP into your SPT installation directory
  2. Launch SPT
  3. Edit In game using F12 then refresh resolution

Recommended settings

Resolution Scale Percent
1080p 100 (no change)
1440p 75–85
4K 50–75

Requirements

  • SPT 4.0.13
  • Client-side only — no server mod needed
